verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ScrapingBee scrapes pages on demand, and its CLI offers cron-based scheduled jobs. A recurring scrape is a different thing from change detection. No evidence shows ScrapingBee comparing page content over time or sending notifications or webhooks when price or listing content changes, so this would be a user-built workaround on top of scheduling and extraction primitives.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can monitor target pages for content changes, such as price or listing updates, and get notified as they happen
